title: Barbell Bench Press
description: Classic compound chest exercise. Lie flat on bench and press the barbell from chest to full arm extension.

title: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Upper chest focused press on an inclined bench (30-45°) using dumbbells.

title: Cable Chest Fly
description: Isolation movement using cables for constant tension across the chest.

title: Push-Ups
description: Bodyweight chest exercise. Keep core tight and lower chest to just above the floor.

title: Decline Bench Press
description: Targets the lower chest. Set bench to a decline angle and press barbell.

title: Pull-Ups
description: Compound upper-back exercise. Hang from bar and pull body up until chin clears the bar.

title: Barbell Row
description: Hinge at hips and pull barbell toward lower chest. Major compound back builder.

title: Lat Pulldown
description: Cable machine exercise targeting the lats. Pull bar to upper chest while leaning slightly back.

title: Deadlift
description: King of all exercises. Pull barbell from floor to hip level with a straight back.

title: Face Pulls
description: Cable exercise for rear delts and upper traps. Pull rope to face level with elbows high.

title: Overhead Press
description: Standing barbell press above the head. Core tight, press from shoulders to full lockout.

title: Lateral Raises
description: Dumbbell side raises targeting the medial deltoid. Raise to shoulder height with slight bend.

title: Rear Delt Fly
description: Bent-over dumbbell raises targeting the rear deltoid and upper back.

title: Arnold Press
description: Rotating dumbbell press that hits all three heads of the deltoid.

title: Barbell Curl
description: Classic bicep exercise. Curl barbell from hip level to shoulder height.

title: Hammer Curl
description: Neutral grip curl targeting the brachialis and brachioradialis alongside biceps.

title: Tricep Rope Pushdown
description: Cable pushdown with rope attachment targeting the triceps. Keep elbows pinned to sides.

title: Skull Crushers
description: Lying tricep extension with EZ-bar. Lower bar to forehead level and extend.

title: Wrist Curls
description: Seated forearm isolation exercise with barbell or dumbbell.

title: Barbell Back Squat
description: Primary leg compound. Bar on upper traps, squat until thighs are parallel to floor.

title: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hip-hinge movement targeting the hamstrings. Keep legs mostly straight and bar close to body.

title: Leg Press
description: Machine-based quad dominant exercise. Press platform away while keeping back flat.

title: Walking Lunges
description: Unilateral leg exercise alternating legs. Step forward and lower knee toward ground.

title: Calf Raises
description: Standing or seated calf raises targeting the gastrocnemius and soleus.

title: Hip Thrust
description: Glute-dominant exercise with barbell across hips. Drive hips up to full extension.

title: Leg Curl
description: Machine hamstring isolation exercise. Curl heels toward glutes against resistance.

title: Sumo Squat
description: Wide-stance squat targeting inner thighs and adductors alongside glutes.

title: Plank
description: Isometric core hold. Maintain straight body line from head to heels.

title: Cable Crunch
description: Weighted crunch using cable machine. Kneel and crunch elbows toward knees.

title: Russian Twist
description: Rotational core exercise. Sit at 45° and rotate torso side to side with weight.

title: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hang from pull-up bar and raise legs to 90° or higher for lower ab emphasis.

title: Side Plank
description: Lateral isometric hold targeting the obliques and lateral core stability.
